findings.label: Joint capsule  [CHECK]
findings.now_desc: red muscle fibres ~15px lateral to the pale grey capsule band (~x756,y336)
findings.target_desc: the pale capsule band hugging the metatarsal neck

findings.now_desc: extracapsular tissue at the muscle/capsule junction (~x758,y382)
findings.target_desc: the thin lining on the inner aspect of the capsule

findings.label: Sesamoid bones (medial & lateral) (left panel, item 4)  [CHECK]
findings.now_desc: the first metatarsal diaphysis (~x297,y558); the 4 badge sits distal-lateral to the sesamoid pair
findings.target_desc: the two small ovals overlying the metatarsal head

findings.label: Phalanges (left panel, item 6)  [CHECK]
findings.now_desc: the 5th metatarsal shaft just proximal to the 5th MTP joint (~x437,y613)
findings.target_desc: the phalanges of the 5th toe, one bone distal

pages.note: Every one of the order's nine coordinates was checked and eight carry real leader ink (15-51 px in a 13x13 box). Row 5 is the exception and confirms the order: it samples (14,18,21), near-black, i.e. the empty background the order describes - there is no numbered 5 badge on the foot at all. Rows 3 and 4 are a displaced pair: Plantar plate currently ends ON a sesamoid, and Sesamoid bones ends in the phalangeal trabecular bone.
